technical.summary: MCK shows strong trend structure with multiple moving average bullish alignments and Ichimoku confirmation, but momentum divergence (MACD crossover down, RSI21 bearish, StochRSI overbought) and weak volume suggest caution on new entries; better suited for existing longs or pullback entries.

fundamental.summary: MCK shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 82 days present material risk with insufficient fundamental conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (12/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior members offers minimal conviction support; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (415.5), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, and rising dollar pressuring multinationals; earnings in 82 days provides some buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable for risk assets.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical structure (SMA golden cross, Ichimoku confirmation, price above major MAs, supertrend bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (12/100) creating contrarian buy opportunity in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Momentum divergence (MACD bearish crossover, RSI21 weakening, StochRSI overbought), critically weak fundamentals (score 3, zero insider activity, high earnings risk in 82 days), severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar), and below-average volume support undermine technical setup.
